description: Create a new flow record to track a unit of work. A flow represents one user request and all spawned actions within it.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: New flow record created with flow_id for action correlation and tracking
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creating a new flow record to track a unit of work and correlate actions
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError with 'session_id': session ID is required. ValidationError with 'trigger_type': trigger type must be specified. DatabaseError: failed to insert flow record into core__flows table.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For session_id errors: ensure a valid session_id is provided. For trigger_type errors: specify the trigger type (e.g., user_input, scheduled_task, webhook). For database errors: verify database connectivity and retry.
